author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In the AI era, you only do a thing exactly 3 times 

1. Do it by hand or semi-auto with AI assistance to know what it is about 

2. Create an AI skill to do the same task

3. Test the new skill to make sure it is reliable 

That's it, from this point onward, you never have to do the same task again. You let AI do it for you
